answer: Running a farm thus means funding each duplicate self through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent forfeits once and never again. Because the age is read from the copper checkpoint rather than self-declared, the spiral audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 4 epochs old on the canyon ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint.
